application.name: Request for Advance Payment to Suppliers
application.description: Allows users request the advance payment to suppliers

instruction.instruction:
Solicitação de Pagamento Antecipado a Fornecedores

 

Esta solicitação é válida para Fornecedores: Nacionais e Internacionais

  • Pagamento Antecipado (Fornecedores Nacionais e Internacionais)
  • Pagamento à vista (Apenas para Fornecedores Internacionais)

Lembramos que estes processos devem estar de acordo com o regulamento 10 e regulamento 3.

translation.value:
Remarks:

          ► Attach to this request all documents required in reg.10.

          ► Cases with guarantee: Attach the documentation specified in reg.10.

          ► Approvals according to reg.3 and exceptions according to reg.10

          ► In case of lack of guarantee, RBLA/P approval is mandatory,

          ► The payment condition of the order must be:

  • 009 E for "Advance" payment

    Important: If the conditions in the order/contract/guarantee are not in accordance with the information above, the WorkON will be rejected.
